items.answer:
AT: Hi W****! My name is Alex your product assistant today, and I'll be glad to help.
Thank you for being so interested in our product.
HP 2723 uses dye-based ink which can also be used to print labels or stickers. However, if you use it for stickers with a long shelf life that will be exposed to a lot of light it is advisable to use a pigment-ink-based printer like HP 9010e. 
Should you have other concerns, please don't hesitate to contact us; we'd be happy to assist.

Once again, thank you for reaching the HP Official Store. Have a great day!

aiTexts: The HP DeskJet DJ 2932 is an all-in-one color inkjet printer designed for home and small office use
It supports printing, scanning, and copying with a print speed of up to 10 pages per minute in both black and color
Compatible with A4, B5, Legal, and Letter paper sizes, plus cards, photo paper, and labels
Equipped with HP 67 series original ink cartridges, including high-yield options for cost efficiency
Connects via USB and Wi-Fi, fully compatible with HP Smart mobile app for easy operation and scanning to PDF
Features a user-friendly icon LCD display and supports standard input of 60 sheets and output of 25 sheets
Designed with a compact white body suitable for limited spaces
Built to operate reliably in typical home office environments with a 1-year local warranty and 24-hour support service.

aiTexts: The Canon imageCLASS MF664Cdw is a compact 3-in-1 colour multifunction printer designed for efficient office use.
It supports printing, scanning, and copying with a recommended monthly volume of 250-2,500 pages and a max duty cycle of 30,000 pages.
Features include a 1200MHz processor, 1GB memory, 4GB storage, and a 12.7 cm colour touchscreen for easy control.
Print speed ranges from 21-30 ppm with double-sided printing and 1200 x 1200 DPI resolution.
It operates quietly and efficiently with low power consumption, fitting well in various work environments.
